text: In CTT, `transp` (primitive transport) computes transport along a line of types A: I→Type. The defining computation rule is:
choices: transp A i0 a ≡ a (transport along the constant path is identity)
transp A φ a ≡ ua a
transp A φ a is always non-trivial
explanation: transp (λ _ → A) i0 a ≡ a: transporting along a constant line is the identity.
